claims.claim: NVIDIA showed a BlueField-4 STX server for context memory at OCP 2026 as a lower-cost design than a previously shown dual-Vera board.
claims.episode_span: NVIDIA showed the BlueField-4 STX server for context memory at OCP 2026
claims.source_title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Server for CMX at OCP 2026
claims.supporting_quote: At OCP 2026, we saw the new NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Server for Context Memory (CMX). Partners had been asking for this, and NVIDIA delivered. Onboard, we have a lower-cost design than the dual-Vera setup we saw previously.

claims.claim: The earlier BlueField-4 paired two Vera CPUs, each with SOCAMM memory, and four ConnectX-9 SuperNICs.
claims.episode_span: The earlier BlueField-4 paired two Vera CPUs, each with SOCAMM memory, and four ConnectX-9 SuperNICs
claims.source_title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Server for CMX at OCP 2026
claims.supporting_quote: That one, pictured below, is a dual Vera CPU setup, each with SOCAMM memory, plus four ConnectX-9 SuperNICs.

claims.claim: The STX board uses SOCAMM and LPDDR5X with a soldered CPU, and is roughly the size of an Intel DMR 16-channel socket or a 16-channel AMD EPYC Venice platform.
claims.episode_span: A soldered CPU and LPDDR5X, instead of DDR5 DIMM slots, keep the board about the size of an Intel DMR 16-channel socket
claims.source_title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Server for CMX at OCP 2026
claims.supporting_quote: A soldered CPU and LPDDR5X here, over traditional DDR5 DIMM slots, give NVIDIA a platform where the “motherboard” is roughly the size of an Intel DMR 16-channel socket or a 16-channel AMD EPYC Venice platform.

claims.claim: ServeTheHome did not see a ConnectX-9 SuperNIC on the BlueField-4 STX boards shown at OCP 2026.
claims.episode_span: ServeTheHome did not see a ConnectX-9 SuperNIC on the OCP boards
claims.source_title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Server for CMX at OCP 2026
claims.supporting_quote: Something notable that we did not see on the boards shown at OCP 2026, or at least in our photos of them from various booths, is an NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNIC.

claims.claim: Quantinuum reported 99.9995 percent logical memory fidelity on Helios, about five failures per million cycles.
claims.episode_span: Quantinuum reported 99.9995 percent logical memory fidelity on its Helios quantum computer
claims.source_title: Quantinuum Says Helios Results Strengthen Its Path to Apollo
claims.supporting_quote: The company reported 99.9995% logical memory fidelity, equivalent to roughly five failures per million cycles.

claims.claim: Quantinuum CEO Rajeeb Hazra told The Wall Street Journal, "This derisks the industry."
claims.episode_span: Chief executive Rajeeb Hazra told The Wall Street Journal, "This derisks the industry."
claims.source_title: Quantinuum Says Helios Results Strengthen Its Path to Apollo
claims.supporting_quote: “This derisks the industry,” Quantinuum CEO Rajeeb Hazra told The Wall Street Journal.

claims.claim: Quantinuum's Apollo fault-tolerant target is 2029.
claims.episode_span: Quantinuum still dates Apollo, its planned fault-tolerant system, to 2029.
claims.source_title: Quantinuum Says Helios Results Strengthen Its Path to Apollo
claims.supporting_quote: Quantinuum says a new error-correction result on its Helios quantum computer gives it greater confidence in a 2029 target for Apollo, its planned fault-tolerant system.

claims.claim: Arm said Modal's early benchmarks show NVIDIA Vera delivering up to 2x the throughput of comparable x86 systems under heavy concurrency.
claims.episode_span: Modal's early benchmarks show NVIDIA Vera, built on Arm, delivering up to twice the throughput
claims.source_title: Arm-Based NVIDIA Vera Shows 2x Throughput in Agentic AI Benchmarks
claims.supporting_quote: @modal's early benchmarks show @NVIDIA Vera, built on Arm, delivering up to 2x the throughput of comparable x86 systems under heavy concurrency.

claims.claim: NVIDIA announced a record quantum simulation on JUPITER validating magic-state cultivation that requires 90 percent fewer qubits than previous methods.
claims.episode_span: The run validated magic-state cultivation, an approach to fault-tolerant quantum computing that requires 90 percent fewer qubits
claims.source_title: NVIDIA Runs Record Simulation of Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing at Jülich Supercomputing Centre
claims.supporting_quote: NVIDIA today announced a record-breaking quantum computing simulation on JUPITER, Europe’s first exascale supercomputer, allowing researchers to fully explore and validate magic state cultivation — a leading approach to fault-tolerant quantum computing that requires 90% fewer qubits than previous methods.

claims.claim: A superconducting neural-network chip passed tests processing fusion-reactor data, with Great Sky partnered with Brookhaven, Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory, and DIII-D.
claims.episode_span: A superconducting neural-network chip that borrows techniques from quantum computers passed a battery of tests
claims.source_title: Superconducting Neuromorphic Chip Passes Fusion Test
claims.supporting_quote: A superconducting neural network chip that borrows tricks from quantum computers has successfully passed a battery of tests that involved processing data from a fusion reactor.

claims.claim: A bigger Great Sky chip is planned for more fusion testing next year.
claims.episode_span: A bigger Great Sky chip is slated for more fusion testing next year.
claims.source_title: Superconducting Neuromorphic Chip Passes Fusion Test
claims.supporting_quote: The Genesis Mission project paves the way to the development of a bigger chip for more fusion testing next year

claims.supporting_quote: According to Bloomberg, the petition was filed on October 16 and made public on Monday.

claims.claim: Intel said its US fabs rely on AGVs from Murata Machinery and Daifuku, with no validated US alternative, and full replacement would take years.
claims.episode_span: fabs rely on automated guided vehicles long supplied by Japan's Murata Machinery and Daifuku
claims.source_title: US Robot Ban Stalls Chip Capacity; Intel Seeks Waiver, TSMC and Others May Follow
claims.supporting_quote: Intel said there is currently no validated US-made alternative that meets its stringent standards, and that fully replacing existing equipment would take years.

claims.claim: Aurora has 10,624 nodes and 63,744 GPUs; the cosmology runs used 8,100 nodes and about 50,000 GPUs and finished in about four days.
claims.episode_span: The system has 10,624 nodes and 63,744 GPUs.
claims.source_title: Argonne’s Aurora Supercomputer Powers 2 of the Largest Cosmological Simulations to Date
claims.supporting_quote: One of the world’s largest supercomputers, the system has 10,624 nodes and 63,744 graphics processing units (GPUs).

claims.claim: Each Aurora cosmology simulation tracked 13.4 trillion dark-matter particles across 28.6 billion light-years, and the two runs wrote more than 85 petabytes through DAOS, with about 8 petabytes kept.
claims.episode_span: Each one followed 13.4 trillion dark-matter particles across a region 28.6 billion light-years wide.
claims.source_title: Argonne’s Aurora Supercomputer Powers 2 of the Largest Cosmological Simulations to Date
claims.supporting_quote: Each simulation modeled the evolution of 13.4 trillion dark matter particles across a region 28.6 billion light-years wide.
